> [!IMPORTANT]
> v1.1.1 fixes podcast repeat-one playback and adds an optional stop-after-each mode and podcast-first cache cleanup.
>
> v1.1.1 修复播客单集循环，新增可选的“播完即停”模式，并优先清理播客音频缓存。

## What’s new

- **Podcast repeat-one:** Fixed episodes repeating only the last few seconds instead of restarting from the beginning.
- **Optional stop after each item:** Enable it in Settings → Player & audio → Queue, then use the Shuffle button to select it. Off by default; local playback only and limited to the current queue. Turning the setting off also deactivates the mode.
- **Audio cache cleanup:** Remove podcast audio before music when the streaming cache reaches its limit. Downloaded files are unaffected.

## Before you update

- Requires **Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device**.
- On-device recognition is **experimental and available for RSS podcasts in English, German, Spanish, and Japanese**.

## 主要更新

- **播客单集循环：** 修复只重复最后几秒、没有从头播放的问题。
- **可选的播完即停：** 在“设置 → 播放器与音频 → 待播列表”中开启，再通过随机播放按钮切换。默认关闭，仅适用于本地播放和当前队列；关闭设置也会解除当前模式。
- **音频缓存清理：** 在线播放缓存达到上限时，播客音频比歌曲更早清理；不影响已下载文件。

## 更新说明

- 需要 **Android 8.0 或更新系统，以及 ARM64 设备**。
- 端侧识别是面向 **RSS 播客的实验性功能，支持英语、德语、西班牙语和日语**。
